From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: procurement checklist & next steps for Lighthouse AI

Hi Ana — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the key ask items so we can get procurement moving on your side. I captured the items we discussed and flagged the decisions we need from you.

High-level recap
- Redwood Inference: hosted + dedicated options, same API surface, predictable SLAs + marketplace availability.
- Lighthouse AI use case: embeddings + retrieval augmentation for search (initial prod load ~3M tokens/day).

Procurement & commercial path (what we covered)
1) Payment method: you mentioned internal preference for PO for anything >$25k/year. If that holds, we should confirm who on your side signs POs.
2) Card: short-term pilot can be run on card (no PO required) to accelerate demos.
3) Marketplace: you asked about AWS Marketplace listing. We have a presence; we can provide a marketplace contract route which simplifies purchasing for some of your procurement folks.
4) Security/compliance: requested vendor questionnaire and SOC2 evidence. We can share our standard packets.

Action items for Lighthouse (please confirm):
- Budget owner / economic buyer name and email
- Finance sponsor / charge-code owner
- Signatory (who signs POs) and any required procurement form
- Target procurement timeline (date) for a Q1 pilot or production window

Attachments: I attached a short post-call checklist + our standard PO template and the vendor security questionnaire reference.

Proposed next step: 30-min internal kickoff with procurement + engineering next week. I suggested Tue 11/17 10:00am PT — does that work?

Thanks — I’ll loop in Ben (billing) and Monica (contracting) so we can narrow the paperwork once you confirm names.

Best,
Grace
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Hi Grace — great notes, thanks for the clear recap. Confirming details on our side below. I put Carlos (Head of Data Platform) on copy who will be the budget owner.

Quick answers:
- Budget owner / economic buyer: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@lighthouse.ai> (owns this initiative).
- Finance sponsor / cost center: Mei Chen (Finance Manager) — finance@lighthouse.ai (handles charge codes).
- Signatory / PO process: Procurement requires a PO for contracts >$25k/year. The signatory for such contracts is our SVP of Operations (Maria Santos). Procurement will accept the vendor PO template but will want our standard terms attached; they sometimes request a 60-day net payment.
- Marketplace: We prefer marketplace for smaller recurring services but for platform-level deals we'll likely do a direct PO (marketplace adds a 3rd party flow that our legal wants to avoid for platform integrations).
- Timeline: We are planning vendor selection by end of Dec; pilot kickoff target mid-Jan. Procurement wants vendor paperwork and SOC2 in the next 2 weeks.

I'll attach the procurement intake form (internal) — procurement@lighthouse.ai will follow up if they need anything else.

Thanks — Tue 11/17 10am PT works for Carlos and me.

Best,
Ana Ruiz
Head of Product Partnerships
Lighthouse AI

Good plan — a couple of quick notes before the kickoff:

1) Billing summary: I'll produce a short doc comparing card vs PO vs marketplace. Key callouts: marketplace adds a procurement/third-party invoicing layer and can delay cash collection by ~30 days; use PO for multi-year commitments to get standard pricing and invoice cadence.

2) Suggested talking points for Carlos (economic buyer):
- Pilot KPIs to win budget signoff: 1) 20% improvement in search relevance by month 1 of pilot, 2) 99th percentile latency target, 3) cost per 1M tokens.
- Rollout model: pilot on card to de-risk + switch to PO for production once volume stabilizes.

3) Risk flags / redlines: Monica, flag any T&Cs that usually need legal (e.g., IP assignment, data residency, indemnity). If procurement insists on 60-day net, we should ask for a mid-point (45 days) as standard.

I'll attach my billing comparison ahead of the Tue meeting.

—Ben
Account Strategy | Redwood Inference
